text:
Type: opal glass globe ceiling lamp
Use: general light close to the ceiling or on a wall; bathroom, hallway, corridor
Style: traditional, classic, retro
Materials: white opal glass globe, brushed nickel-plated metal mount
Colors: milky white, brushed silver
Shape: round glass ball held by a stepped circular metal canopy, sits close to the ceiling or wall, compact and simple
Feel: soft, tidy, nostalgic, calm
Goes with: white tiles, chrome or nickel fittings, pale walls; classic or traditional bathrooms and hallways
